notes.title: Pirates Outlaws 2: Heritage | Development Update
notes.notes: [p]Ahoy Mateys,[/p][p]The last few weeks after beta-test period were intense.[/p][p]Based on players' constructive feedback, we have adjusted several core gameplays, difficulty and more...[/p][p][/p][p]Over the past weeks, new additional content has been implemented to improve the player experience and enhanced player in-game progress.[/p][p]Unannounced additional content and major features are also being tested internally. It's now a great time to share our development progress.[/p][p][/p][p][b]About Difficulty[/b][/p][p]A key recurring point in player feedback comes from the game difficulty. Several cards' value, attributes, enemies’ action countdown, rewards have been balanced.[/p][p][/p][p]New supportive implementations offer more flexibility for players to build a deck and navigate the map freely:[/p][p]• Exclusive relic after beating an Elite/Boss[/p][p]• New supportive events during a journey[/p][p]• All region areas unlock progress adjustment and have their own difficulty (includes Kraken Area)[/p][p]• Additional cards and relics added to post-battle awards[/p][p]• New “Strategist” Outfit[/p][p][/p][p][b]About Player Progress[/b][/p][p]Fair game progression across all platforms is essential to provide gaming experience that's suitable for everyone. To achieve this balance, the game's difficulty can be changed at any time, making it more rewarding and less demeaning.[/p][p][/p][p]Additionally, progression and unlocking of core content (classes and companions) have been adjusted so players can more quickly discover a class that suits their needs.[/p][p]• Quicker access to Gabi's first classes[/p][p]• More "Heritages" options added and unlock progress optimized[/p][p]• Caravan shop added with premium packages and additional contents: Relics "Tamer" Outfit package, Cards "Hunter" package, Hero Asier and Companion Octopus[/p][p][/p][p][b]About Major New Contents[/b][/p][p]Pirates Outlaws is a roguelike deckbuilder for all.[/p][p]A pirate themed exploration game that is easy to play. It should offer enough content to build varied strategies and discover new cards or relics combos for each game. But the game must also be adapted to players looking for a challenge.[/p][p]• New "Cryptex" panel[/p][p]• Old Town with “Black Market and Workshop” to trade rare resources[/p][p]• Arena I (Beta)[/p][p][/p][p][b]About Extra Features[/b][/p][p]• New condition "Mark"[/p][p]• Additional Passives: "Dodge", "Trample" and more[/p][p]• Card Effects: Ephemerate[/p][p]• New bosses and updates of several existing bosses[/p][p][/p][p][i]*This is a rough plan; features are all subject to change[/i][/p][p][/p][p]We‘d like to say more once these ideas are more solidified, but for now, we are keeping our plans close to the vest.[/p][p][/p][p]To stay fully updated, check our spoilers from now on. Please don't forget to keep an eye on our announcement of official release.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for all the love and support![/p][p][/p][p]Fabled[/p]

notes.title: DEMO Patch Notes #3
notes.notes:
Map Updates
● Secret Islands
    ○ Level restrictions removed.
● Monkey Island
    ○ Temporarily closed.
● Map System Rework
    ○ New regions unlock progressively upon completing stage objectives.
    ○ Map complexity increases slightly with unlocked regions. (Currently available regions: Small, Medium, Large)
● Relic Rarity System added.

Enemy:
● Elysian Explorers
    ○ Skill changed: Gain Healing → Gain Immunity.
● Fire Wolves (early encounter)
    ○ Now persist until defeated.
● Economy Tweaks:
    ○ Increased gold rewards in early phases of NAVIGATION mode.
    ○ Reduced gold penalty on death.

Classes:
● Gabi - Vigilante:
    ○ Max HP increased: 40 → 45
    ○ Ammo capacity increased: 2 → 3
● Gabi - Renegade
    ○ Unlock requirement level in Alchemy Shop reduced – now available earlier.

Cards:
● Captain's Pistol
    ○ No longer gets Removed after use. 
    ○ Damage adjusted: 13 → 11.
● Cursed Bone Pistol
    ○ Applies 3 Injury
    ○ Reduce cards: 2 → 1.
● Push
    ○ Can now target any position.
    ○ Damage increased: 7 → 8.
● Spell Upgrade Tree changes
    ○ Thorn Trap removed from upgrade tree (can be found in cards pool)
    ○ New Cards: Firelight → Wildfire branch added
● Legendary Sword
    ○ Damage increased: 14 → 16.
● Spell Card
    ○ Now triggers enemy Countdown.
● Wild Brambles
    ○ Reduced Injury applied:

        ■ Target: 10 → 8
        ■ Adjacent enemies: 7 → 5
● First Mate's Pistol
    ○ Damage reduced: 11 → 10.
● Curse Card descriptions polished.
(Note: All changes are subject to further balancing during development.)

If you encounter any issues causing the game to crash and cannot even start, please follow the steps:  In the "Start Game" screen, click the settings menu in the upper-right corner, and select "Reset Journey." After resetting, you should be able to playing normally. Please report this kind of issue to us, we will fix it asap.
2. The DEMO is Windows only (for now).
3. Permanent DEMO Access: This DEMO is not time-limited and will remain available even after the full game launches. However, progress from the DEMO will not carry over to the full version.
4. Bug Reporting: If you encounter any issues, please use the "Report Bug" button in the game settings. Alternatively, feel free to share your feedback directly with us through our community.
5. Feedback & Surveys: A feedback survey for the DEMO will be available soon. In the meantime, we welcome your thoughts and suggestions via our community or email.
6. Localization Updates: Some minor language issues may still be present. We are actively working with our localization partners to optimize and proofread all text.
7. Multilingual Support: Additional languages (Japanese, Korean, French, German, Spanish, Russian, English, and Simplified/Traditional Chinese) will be available at the full game launch. If you’re interested in assisting with localization, please refer to the FAQ section for more details.
8. The DEMO does not represent the final quality of the game. We are continuously refining and improving the experience!

notes.title: Open Beta Test Will End Tomorrow
notes.notes:
Hey, Captains!

After several weeks of testing, the testing phase will come to a successful close tomorrow (Beijing Time: November 22nd, 10AM). We would like to express our heartfelt gratitude to each and every player who participated in the test. It is your active feedback and valuable suggestions that have allowed us to continuously optimize the game.

During the testing phase, you provided a wealth of insightful feedback, covering gameplay improvements, bug reports and etc. We have been analyzing your input accordingly. Your feedback not only made us aware of the areas that need optimization, but also inspired us to continue striving for better quality.

Looking ahead, we will continue to refine the game and develop more new contents, aiming to deliver an even more polished and exciting official version. We look forward to embarking on new adventures together with all of you when officially launches.

Once again, thank you to all our players for your support and dedication! 

Stay tuned!
Fabled Studio

notes.title: PO2 | Open Beta Testing Period Extended
notes.notes:
Ahoy Mateys:

How far has everyone progressed in the game? Over the past few days of testing, we've received a lot of feedback and comments, and we sincerely thank you all!

Your voices have made us realize that a week of gameplay might not be sufficient. To ensure you have enough time to fully experience the content implemented so far, we've decided to extend the testing period until November 22th (CST). We genuinely hope this extra time will allow you to share even more of your thoughts and feedbacks with us, so we can meet with you in a better quality when we officially release!

During this period, we will also update more gameplay content with you (based on the actual development progress).

Thank you for your continued support, understanding, and for being such an important part of this journey with us.

Best,
Fabled Game

notes.title: Open Beta Test Available Now
notes.notes:
Before you start, we have a few things to remind you:
• There is no Save & Load in this current version, which means if you decide to quit the game during a journey, your current PROGRESS and rewards will be lost.
• 1 character “Gabi” with 3 classes “Vigilante”, Renegade” and “Sword Master”. Each class has unique attributes, 1 ability card and a pre-made starter deck.
• After completing 3 quests and defeating the sea masters, you can choose to return home or explore the area more.
• Some characters, backgrounds, user interface, animations... are still in development. We may change or improve them in the future.
Not yet implemented:
• More characters and their classes.
• More Companions
• Upgrade Panel (Can improve your hero attributes, ship upgrades and additional exploration functions or mechanics)
• Game mode “Arena”
• Additional regions and maps.
• Add cards, effects and buttons SFX, and several soundtracks are not yet completed.
Test period: October 28th - November 4th CST
Open Beta Test data will be wiped at the end of the testing period.
